# Overview

VONQ’s current operations involve several internal teams, specifically finance, commercial/CRM, data/analytics, and senior leadership. These groups are actively engaged in activities related to exit preparation and investor reporting. The processes underway leverage an established ecosystem of business systems, including the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and the Qlik Warehouse, which serves as the primary data and reporting platform.

Reporting and analytics at VONQ are managed through Qlik-based tools, utilizing the Qlik Warehouse and associated modules. Data is sourced from the Finance System, CRM, ERP, as well as supporting Excel-based datasets and potentially other external sources. The Qlik Warehouse forms the backbone of the organization’s cloud/platform infrastructure, facilitating data consolidation and access for trended data spanning a minimum of three years, with legacy sources included as required.

Integration across these systems faces select challenges; not all source systems have automated connections into the Qlik Warehouse, necessitating manual, one-off data ingestion. Where ongoing data refresh is required during the transaction, a recurring refresh process is set to be established. This current-state framework supports exit-related reporting but relies on both automated and manual processes for comprehensive data coverage and integration.
